    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    edges = []
    index = 1
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        ai = int(input[index])
        bi = int(input[index + 1])
        edges.append((ai, bi))
        index += 2
    values = list(map(int, input[index:]))

    tree = defaultdict(list)
    for ai, bi in edges:
        tree[ai].append(bi)
        tree[bi].append(ai)

    def dfs(node, parent):
        total = values[node - 1]
        for neighbor in tree[node]:
            if neighbor != parent:
                total += dfs(neighbor, node)
        return total

    result = abs(dfs(1, -1))
    print(result)
